title: hebe ciliolata
intro: Hebe ciliolata, commonly known as the alpine hebe, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand and Australia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions, including wound healing, anti-cancer, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Hebe ciliolata include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
